# wisp-science v1.25.0 — Word Review and Jump Hosts

**Wisp can propose edits to a Word file as tracked changes that you accept or reject, and it can reach SSH servers that sit behind a jump host.** Long conversations and large projects are lighter, several paths that could lose conversation history or settings are closed, and each conversation keeps its own right pane. The SwiftUI and WinUI desktop previews are retired in favour of one GPUI desktop, which is still an early preview.

## Word tracked changes

- Two new tools, `read_docx` and `suggest_docx_edit`, let the agent read a `.docx` paragraph by paragraph and save its proposed edits as native Word tracked changes in a separate revision copy.
- The preview shows insertions and deletions as Word does. Accept or reject each change, or use **Accept all deletions** and **Accept all rewrites**; a rewrite is reviewed as one item. Reviewing a writable local file saves that file and keeps the bytes from before the review under `.wisp/docx-review/`.
- Asked to polish, rewrite, shorten or translate an existing `.docx`, the agent now goes through tracked changes instead of regenerating the file from a script and overwriting it. The review bar can be resized. See [DOCX revisions](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/docx-revisions.md).

## SSH jump hosts

- The SSH host editor has an optional **Jump host (ProxyJump)** field: `alice@bastion:2222`, an alias from your SSH config, or several hops separated by commas. Leave it blank to keep your SSH config, or enter `none` for a direct connection.
- The same route is used by connection tests, probes, Runs, persistent runtimes, the remote file browser, file transfers and terminals. Separate jump-host passwords, MFA and port knocking are not automated. See [SSH jump hosts](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/ssh-jump-hosts.md).

## Conversations and previews

- After you send a message, the chat shows "Waiting for the model to respond…" until the first text, thinking or tool call arrives, instead of staying blank under a running conversation.
- Each conversation keeps its own right pane: a new conversation starts with it closed, and reopening the pane returns to the tabs you had open rather than the tool home.
- A PDF preview returns to the page and zoom you last used for that file when you switch tabs and come back. This lasts while the window is open.
- On a card for a conversation that finished in another project, **Open conversation** now goes to the window that already shows that project, including the main window, and restores it if minimized. Cards for finished conversations fade out after about 15 seconds unless the pointer is on them; failed ones stay.
- Ctrl/Cmd+A selects the document you are reading, not the whole window.
- `/share` PNG export wraps long paragraphs, table cells and list items correctly, and can export either one long image or numbered 3:4 pages.
- A failed isolated exploration can be discarded, its files recovered by hand, or the whole round abandoned from the banner; it no longer leaves project writes frozen with no way out.
- Dropping files from Finder onto the Files panel works on macOS.
- Any saved ChatGPT account can be removed, including the last one. While Magpie is connected, model pickers offer only the Magpie model, which is what those turns use.
- The workspace header, Files panel, sidebar selection mode and the delete and move conversation dialogs are tidied. In Chinese, the Publication page is now named 论文整理, and its dropdowns show the stored value.

## Long conversations and large projects

- A running turn with thousands of steps shows its most recent activity and reveals older steps on request, instead of mounting the whole turn.
- Events saved while a turn streams are written in batches rather than one commit each. The once-per-second refreshes of Runs, runtimes and the Agents panel read only what changed, and no longer reload skills or full message history.
- Daily database copies run after the first window appears. Code snapshots are kept for the newest 200 Runs per project and for Runs that are still running, cited by a publication, or part of an open exploration; daily copies are capped at 2 GiB in total, oldest removed first.
- Starting Wisp a second time no longer rotates the running window's log. See [conversation performance](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/conversation-performance.md).

## Data safety and fixes

- **Rewind, edit and branch refuse to run when they cannot locate the turn.** In 1.24.0 this case could cut a long, compacted conversation back to its earliest part and delete everything after it. Quoting turns from a compacted conversation can no longer pick up the wrong turn either.
- Undo works after a conversation has been compacted, and undoes a turn together with instructions added midway and its file changes.
- Model profiles that cannot be read are backed up and the readable ones kept, instead of being replaced as if on a fresh install.
- A Feishu reconnect no longer aborts a running turn or drops messages that were already acknowledged.
- Streams that separate events with CRLF, as some proxies and relays send them, now parse. Anthropic stream errors show the real reason, such as overloaded or invalid request, and are not retried as a dropped connection. A reply cut off by the output limit keeps the text it had produced.
- On Windows, imported projects show ordinary drive-letter paths instead of `\\?\D:\…`, and deleting a project releases its database before removing files.
- Scheduled project tasks now ask before using tools that change things. `write` creates missing parent folders. A re-run delegation workflow no longer reports reused steps as stopped.

## Desktop clients

- The SwiftUI (macOS) and WinUI (Windows) previews are retired. No new installers are built for them; existing download links keep working. The WebView app remains the release for all three desktop platforms.
- A GPUI desktop for macOS, Windows and Linux is under way. It is an early preview that runs from source and covers conversations only. See [GPUI desktop](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/gpui-desktop.md).

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations.
- **Windows**: MSI / NSIS installers, signed with an SSL.com certificate.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **Mobile**: the signed [Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.25.0/wisp-science_1.25.0_android.apk) installs over the previous version. Install iOS through Xcode.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.25.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as the platform workflows finish.

[All changes since v1.24.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.24.0...v1.25.0)

# wisp-science v1.25.0 — Word 修订与跳板机

**Wisp 可以把对 Word 文件的修改写成修订，由你逐条接受或拒绝；也可以连接跳板机后面的 SSH 服务器。** 长对话和大项目更轻，堵上了几条可能丢失对话历史或设置的路径，每个对话有了自己的右侧面板。SwiftUI 和 WinUI 桌面预览版停止维护，改为统一的 GPUI 桌面端，目前还是早期预览。

## Word 修订

- 新增 `read_docx` 和 `suggest_docx_edit` 两个工具：Agent 按段落读取 `.docx`，把建议的修改保存为 Word 原生修订，写入单独的修订副本。
- 预览中按 Word 的方式显示插入和删除。可以逐条接受或拒绝，也可以用 **接受所有删除** 和 **接受所有改写**；一处改写作为一条审阅。审阅可写的本地文件时会保存该文件，审阅前的内容保留在 `.wisp/docx-review/` 下。
- 让 Agent 润色、改写、缩写或翻译已有的 `.docx` 时，它会走修订流程，不再用脚本重新生成并覆盖文件。审阅栏可以调整大小。详见 [DOCX 修订](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/docx-revisions.md)。

## SSH 跳板机

- SSH 主机编辑器新增可选的 **跳板机（ProxyJump）** 字段：可填 `alice@bastion:2222`、本机 SSH config 里的别名，或用逗号分隔的多级跳板。留空沿用 SSH config，填 `none` 则直连。
- 连接测试、探测、Runs、持久运行时、远程文件浏览、文件传输和终端都走同一条线路。暂不自动处理独立的跳板机密码、多因素验证和端口敲门。详见 [SSH 跳板机](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/ssh-jump-hosts.md)。

## 对话与预览

- 发送消息后，在第一段文字、思考或工具调用出现之前，对话区会显示「等待模型响应…」，不再是「运行中」却一片空白。
- 每个对话有自己的右侧面板：新对话默认关闭面板；重新打开面板时回到之前打开的标签，而不是工具首页。
- PDF 预览在切换标签页再返回时，会回到该文件上次查看的页码和缩放。在窗口打开期间有效。
- 其他项目的对话完成后弹出的卡片上，**打开会话** 会转到已经显示该项目的窗口（包括主窗口），最小化的窗口会先恢复。「任务已完成」的卡片约 15 秒后自动淡出，鼠标停在上面时不会消失；「任务失败」的卡片保留。
- Ctrl/Cmd+A 只选中正在阅读的文档，不再选中整个窗口。
- `/share` 导出 PNG 时，长段落、表格单元格和列表项能正确换行；可以导出一张长图，也可以导出带页码的 3:4 多图。
- 失败的隔离探索可以丢弃、手动取回文件，或从横幅放弃整轮探索，不再出现项目写入被冻结却找不到解除入口的情况。
- macOS 上从 Finder 把文件拖进文件面板可以正常上传。
- 可以移除任意已保存的 ChatGPT 账号，包括最后一个。连接 Magpie 时，模型选择器只列出 Magpie 模型，与实际使用的模型一致。
- 整理了工作区顶栏、文件面板、侧栏的多选模式，以及删除和移动对话的对话框。「论文证据」页更名为「论文整理」，页面里的下拉框现在显示已保存的值。

## 长对话与大项目

- 运行中的回合有几千个步骤时，只显示最近的活动，更早的步骤按需展开，不再一次挂载整个回合。
- 回合流式输出期间保存的事件改为批量写入，不再每条提交一次。每秒一次的 Runs、运行时和 Agents 面板刷新只读取变化的部分，不再重新加载技能和完整的消息历史。
- 每日数据库备份改到首个窗口出现之后进行。每个项目保留最新 200 个 Run 的代码快照，以及仍在运行、被论文引用或属于未结束探索的 Run 的快照；每日备份总量上限为 2 GiB，超出时先删最旧的。
- 再次启动 Wisp 不会再轮换正在运行的窗口的日志。详见[对话性能](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/conversation-performance.md)。

## 数据安全与修复

- **回溯、编辑和分支在找不到对应回合时会拒绝执行。** 1.24.0 中这种情况可能把一个压缩过的长对话截到最早的一段，并删除之后的全部内容。在压缩过的对话里引用回合，也不会再取到别的回合的内容。
- 对话压缩之后仍可撤销；撤销会连同中途追加的指令和文件改动整轮恢复。
- 模型配置读取失败时，会备份原值并保留仍能读取的条目，不再当作全新安装覆盖。
- 飞书重连不再中止进行中的回合，也不再丢弃已确认收到的消息。
- 以 CRLF 分隔事件的流（部分代理和中转站会这样发送）现在可以正常解析。Anthropic 流式出错时显示真实原因，例如过载或请求无效，不再当作断流反复重连。被输出上限截断的回复会保留已生成的正文。
- Windows 上导入的项目显示普通的盘符路径，不再是 `\\?\D:\…`；删除项目时会先释放数据库再删除文件。
- 项目定时任务使用会改动内容的工具前改为先询问。`write` 会创建缺失的上级目录。委派工作流重跑时，被复用的步骤不再被报告为已停止。

## 桌面客户端

- SwiftUI（macOS）和 WinUI（Windows）预览版停止维护，不再构建新的安装包，已有的下载链接继续有效。三个桌面平台的正式版本仍是 WebView 应用。
- 面向 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 的 GPUI 桌面端正在开发，目前是早期预览，需从源码运行，只覆盖对话功能。详见 [GPUI 桌面端](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.25.0/docs/gpui-desktop.md)。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的签名、公证 DMG，兼容安装支持应用内更新。
- **Windows**：MSI / NSIS 安装包，使用 SSL.com 证书签名。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **移动端**：[签名 Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.25.0/wisp-science_1.25.0_android.apk) 可直接覆盖安装旧版本；iOS 通过 Xcode 安装。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.25.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64、arm64。

各平台流水线完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。
